errors.text_span: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die prozentualen Anteile verschiedener Metalle in Deutschland und der Europäischen Union (EU) über drei Jahre.
errors.evidence: The figure consists of two separate bar charts, not a single bar chart. The description incorrectly implies a single chart.
The color for 2022 is described as 'rosa' (pink), but the figure shows violet.
The color for 2023 is described as 'hellblau' (light blue), but the figure shows grey.
The description incorrectly assigns 8.3% to Aluminium in 2022 for Germany, but 8.3% is the value for Kupfer (Copper) in 2021.
The description incorrectly assigns 11.4% to Aluminium in 2023 for Germany, but 11.4% is the value for Nickel in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 1.0% to Kupfer in 2021 for Germany, but 1.0% is the value for Aluminium in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 2.2% to Kupfer in 2022 for Germany, but 2.2% is the value for Kupfer in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 2.7% to Kupfer in 2023 for Germany, but 2.7% is the value for Aluminium in 2022.
The description incorrectly assigns 11.3% to Nickel in 2021 for Germany, but 11.3% is the value for Kupfer in 2022.
The description incorrectly assigns 1.7% to Nickel in 2023 for Germany, but 1.7% is the value for Aluminium in 2023 for the EU.
The description incorrectly assigns 5.1% to Aluminium in 2021 for the EU, but 5.1% is the value for Kupfer in 2022.
The description incorrectly assigns 4.4% to Aluminium in 2022 for the EU, but 4.4% is the value for Kupfer in 2021.
The description incorrectly assigns 3.2% to Aluminium in 2023 for the EU, but 3.2% is the value for Aluminium in 2021.
The description incorrectly assigns 1.8% to Kupfer in 2023 for the EU, but the figure shows 1.3%.
The description incorrectly assigns 1.3% to Kupfer in 2021 for the EU, but 1.3% is the value for Kupfer in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 1.7% to Kupfer in 2022 for the EU, but 1.7% is the value for Aluminium in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 14.6% to Nickel in 2021 for the EU, but 14.6% is the value for Nickel in 2023.
The description incorrectly assigns 24.3% to Nickel in 2023 for the EU, but 24.3% is the value for Nickel in 2021.
The description does not mention that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are grouped by year and color-coded.
